subject: Security QA gaps on global hardening main 8149bd2
summary: Read-only forensic QA on main 8149bd2ad0060591d262fb9a1685f60ef8b01c63 found a live credential-handling defect plus several enforcement gaps. Public authorization-proof issues #35 and #41 contain raw security-token material. Do not quote, copy, or reuse those values; treat them as compromised evidence and invalidate/rotate through the designated external credential/verifier path. Canonical break-glass/recovery policy already forbids durable secret persistence, but runtime coverage is incomplete: durable issue/proof/log/handoff text lacks a central sensitive-auth-material guard; authority proof accepts opaque evidence payloads without full freshness/consumption/replay enforcement; recovery factor evidence is free-form and lacks freshness/replay/secret-free metadata guarantees; TOTP verification is stateless and therefore requires a consuming recovery transaction to prevent reuse; global security change review relies on self-asserted booleans/non-empty references and does not enforce the policy-required post-change target verification; and UNIVERSAL_AGENT_ENTRYPOINT.md still says a generic roleless launch defaults to PRIMARY while machine/local contracts explicitly deny PRIMARY self-promotion and require roleless demand-driven admission. Current CI is green because these negative security properties are not covered by the suite. Recommended Primary-owned remediation: revoke/rotate exposed credentials; sanitize/close compromised proof artifacts without treating redaction as unleak; add a central durable-secret validator and regression tests; bind proof/recovery receipts to immutable verifier refs, timestamps, expiry, actor/case/nonce and one-time consumption; add a recovery transaction replay ledger; harden ChangeReview with verified receipts and post-change verification; align the human entrypoint with the machine routing contract; then refresh MASTER_HANDOFF after accepted implementation. This message is evidence only and conveys no mutation authority.
